parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the switch or handle of the faucet, typically made of stainless steel. It is small and ergonomically shaped for easy grip.
parts.Functional_description: The switch controls the water flow and temperature by rotating or lifting it to adjust the internal valve mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or tilt to regulate water flow and temperature.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main cylindrical body or frame of the faucet, made of stainless steel, providing structural support.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the internal water channels and valve system, connecting the spout and switch to the water supply.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the central support for other moving parts.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: This is the spout of the faucet, made of stainless steel, extending outward to direct water flow.
parts.Functional_description: It delivers water from the internal channel to the sink, often designed with an aerator for smooth flow.
parts.Movement_description: It may swivel horizontally in some designs to direct water flow to different areas of the sink.
